🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — September 14, 2026

Sun, in Virgo, holds a sextile to Mars, in its fall in Cancer. Two tempers that rarely agree, briefly aligned: what you already own finally finds the words to be counted.

Easier — Agreeing on a figure without feeling robbed by it.
Harder — Agreeing to something because agreeing feels pleasant.
Backdrop — Jupiter and Saturn hold a month-long trine underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars governs you, unsupported in Cancer. Across from you in Libra, Mercury holds the other half of the account. Cardinal fire starts and is invoiced for it. It has stood two weeks; by now the cost is known.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you, out of place in Scorpio. Mars in Cancer makes room for you, and then waits. Fixed earth holds, and holding asks nothing back. Venus has not been in Libra for four weeks.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, is only passing through Libra. From Virgo, Sun sets a figure against the wanting. Air bends, and each bend is invoiced. Since Mercury crossed out of Leo, the question has changed.

♋ CANCER
Moon rules you from Scorpio, without leverage of its own. Sun sextiles you from Virgo: an opening to be reached for. Cardinal water: beginning costs almost nothing. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you from Virgo, untitled. Moon in Scorpio stands at a right angle: friction, and a clear number. Fixed fire pays to hold on. After two weeks of the same angle, the terms are familiar.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Libra untitled. Sun crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Earth shifts until the two options are one. A week ago Mercury was still held by Moon; that is finished.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is a foreigner in Scorpio and improvises. From Cancer, Mars cuts across the appetite. Cardinal air: the beginning has a price on it. The square to Moon that held a week ago has let go.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, falls in Cancer. From Virgo, Sun makes something possible and nothing certain. Water keeps what it has, cheaply. The square of a week ago is off it now.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. Sun squares you from Virgo, and the cost objects. Fire adapts, and every adaptation has a figure. Four weeks of it, long enough to have stopped noticing.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, is at its lowest in Aries: effort costs double. Sun trines you from Virgo, meeting no resistance. Earth begins, and beginning asks little today. Four weeks of this, and none of it is news.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn rules you and is weak in Aries: the grip tightens too soon. Moon squares you from Scorpio: wanting and cost refuse to agree. Air that holds on, charged for holding. Mars let go of it a week ago.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. From Virgo, Sun returns your estimate with corrections. Water that changes shape, charged for each shape. The hold Moon had two weeks ago is not there any more.
